overview.description: The Northern Trust International Quality Dividend Dynamic ETF (IQDY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of non-US companies from developed and emerging markets selected and weighted by dividend yield and other fundamentals. The index aims for higher market risk. IQDY was launched on Apr 12, 2013 and is issued by Northern Trust.
